name: Nová Paka bypass

A.note: Kumburský Újezd: new bypass leaves the old through-town road

B.note: Vidochov: new bypass reaches the retained old-road roundabout; official project includes additional existing-road works

junction.about: The four ring ways of the retained I/16 roundabout at node 6556049779, plus way 1418615945, an access=no service chord joining two ring nodes across the central island (read as part of the same junction; its purpose is not tagged). The bypass joins as a new arm.

baselineNote: The 2025 bypass mainline and its dedicated ramp are excluded before network, raster and vector generation. Old town roads and serving roundabouts remain. This is not a historical reconstruction: the inspected DMR contains the bypass cutting (about 6–8 m below adjacent ground near 50.49429 N, 15.54335 E), and the aerial image shows construction earthworks. These give the mapped corridor an existing-earthwork advantage. Exact local acquisition dates are unverified; excluding OSM ways does not remove those built works. Official project reference is 8.479 km S11.5/70; the mapped new mainline between old-road connections is about 7.4 km, excluding existing-road reconstruction at the ends. Ground depths are uncalibrated regional priors.
